apps.name: Platform
apps.tagline: Who you are, how much you have left, and one call that sees the whole family.

apps.name: ICANERA
apps.tagline: Coin price, valuation, supply, FX, tax rules, chain fees and the public business directory.

apps.name: BodaGoEra
apps.tagline: Stages, ports, journey and delivery quotes, and rider-card checks.

apps.name: SupermarketEra
apps.tagline: Stores, a product catalogue across every category, clearance deals and barcode lookups.

apps.name: FarmAgentEra
apps.tagline: Marketplace listings, a produce price board and crop knowledge.

apps.name: Your business
apps.tagline: Private, owner-issued: payment requests, inventory with expiry tracking, CMMS and booking requests.

endpoints.description: Your app, key mode, approved apps, limits and how much of today's quota is used. The first call to make.

endpoints.summary: The whole family in one call
endpoints.description: A snapshot across every app your key is approved for: the ICAN price, BodaGoEra stages, SupermarketEra stores and FarmAgentEra listings.
The live price of 1 ICAN in any of ~170 currencies, with 24h and 7d change.
OHLC candles in UGX, newest bins last, ready for a chart.
Exchange rates against the Ugandan shilling, with each country's latest inflation.
Which currency each supported country uses.
Published tax brackets and rates for a country. Informational, never tax advice.
Businesses that chose to be listed publicly, with open jobs and notices counts.

endpoints.summary: How the ICAN price is made
endpoints.description: The valuation step by step: the 5,000 UGX floor, FX protection, the USD and UGX inflation legs, the fair price, and how the market price compares. Plus aggregate activity.
Coins held in wallets, holders, coins bought and sold through the platform, and 30-day activity by type. Aggregates only, nothing per person.

params.name: to
params.description: ICAN or a 3-letter currency code. Exactly one side is ICAN.

endpoints.description: At the live price, either way. Indicative: a fee or spread applies when you actually buy or sell.

params.name: operation
params.description: native_transfer, token_transfer, token_approve, contract_call or contract_deploy. Omit for all.

endpoints.description: What a transaction would cost in gas, in the network coin, in USD and in ICAN. An estimate from typical gas units and the gas price the platform team last entered (its age is shown).
The latest sequence number and chain hash of the hash-linked record of ICAN events.

endpoints.summary: Integrity chain: proof for one event
endpoints.description: The event type, its hash and the previous hash, so you can check it links to the event before it. Never the underlying record.
Where riders gather: names, areas and coordinates.
The districts BodaGoEra operates in.
Sea ports used for cross-border journeys, with UN/LOCODE.

params.name: at
params.description: Price for this ISO date-time. Default: now.

endpoints.description: Estimate a ride or cargo fare with the booking engine's own formula: max(minimum, base + per-km x distance) x the time-of-day multiplier, rounded to 100 UGX. Can price for a later time.

params.name: code
params.description: The verification code on the rider card. In the sandbox, any code ending in 'valid' passes.

endpoints.description: Is this the rider the card says? Pass the code from the card's QR. Returns only what a passenger needs.

params.name: at
params.description: Price for this ISO date-time (next 14 days). Default: now.

endpoints.description: Prices a ride, a delivery or cargo between two points, with up to 3 stops. Uses the booking engine's own formula, including the time-of-day multiplier, and can price for a later time.
Stores on SupermarketEra with their city and what they offer.
Wholesale catalogue items: names, brands, units and prices. No stock levels, cost prices or supplier identities.

params.name: code
params.description: Barcode or SKU. In the sandbox try 6001234567890.

endpoints.description: Find a catalogue item by barcode or SKU.
Every category on the platform: how many wholesale catalogue items and how many shelf products each holds.
Products across every category and store: price, brand, barcode, expiry date and any published clearance price. No cost prices, no stock levels.
Reduced prices that stores published on stock nearing its expiry date: original price, price now, discount and days left.
Produce, land and services for sale or hire. No seller identity or contact details: people connect inside the app.
What each crop is asking right now: listing count, lowest, average and highest price, total quantity.
Reference data: season, maturity days, expected yield, soil pH and water needs.

body.name: currency
body.description: UGX (default), USD, KES, TZS or RWF.

body.name: description
body.description: Shown to the payer. Up to 140 characters.

body.name: external_ref
body.description: Your own reference, returned on every read.

endpoints.description: Creates a payment request (a QR code). It does NOT move money: the payer scans it in the ICAN app and approves with their own PIN. Capped per request and per day by the key; needs an Idempotency-Key.
The payment requests this business created through the API, with status (pending, completed, expired) and when each was paid. Never who paid.
Status of one payment request: poll this until it says completed.
Expires a payment request that has not been paid. A paid request cannot be cancelled here.

params.name: status
params.description: all, low, out, expiring, expired or ok.

endpoints.description: Every tracked product in your stores: stock, reorder level, nearest expiry date, days left and an expiry status (expired, critical within 7 days, soon within 30, ok).

params.name: days
params.description: Look ahead this many days (1 to 365).

endpoints.summary: What to sell, discount or pull
endpoints.description: Batches and products by expiry date, first-expired-first-out, with the value at risk, a suggested clearance discount and a price that never falls below cost, and whether you already published it.
Product counts, low and out-of-stock, stock value at cost, how much sits in each expiry band, the value at risk and the next three to expire.
Assets (by status, warranties expiring, cost and book value), consumables below reorder, open requisitions, open and overdue work, department budgets.
Equipment with condition, status, acquisition cost, a computed book value (straight-line or declining balance) and warranty days left.
Consumables at or below their reorder level, with days of cover from the last 30 days of use, the date to reorder by (allowing for lead time) and a suggested quantity.
Requisitions with purpose, urgency, status, estimated cost and delivery dates. No names of requesters.
Jobs with status, priority, due date, progress and an overdue flag. Nobody's name or contact is returned.

body.name: from
body.description: Pickup: lat, lng and an optional label.

body.name: to
body.description: Drop-off: lat, lng and an optional label.

body.name: stops
body.description: Up to 3 intermediate points, each {lat, lng}.

body.name: at
body.description: Price for this ISO date-time (next 14 days).

body.name: notes
body.description: Up to 200 characters for the rider.

endpoints.description: Prices a journey or delivery and creates a booking REQUEST with a confirm link. It does not book, dispatch or charge: the customer opens the link in BodaGoEra, picks a rider and books with their own session and PIN.

params.name: status
params.description: all, awaiting_confirmation, booked, cancelled or expired.

endpoints.description: The booking requests this business created, with status (awaiting_confirmation, booked, cancelled, expired) and, once booked, the ride's state.
Status of one booking request and, once booked, the ride: accepted, started, completed. Never the rider's or customer's identity.
